youtube.title: Why Planes Dim Their Lights Before Takeoff 💡 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
Before takeoff and landing, airlines dim the cabin lights even in daytime. Takeoff and landing are the phases when most aircraft accidents occur. Human eyes need several minutes to adapt from bright light to darkness, so dim lights mean passengers can already see if the power fails and an evacuation begins.
